description: Publish where you can be reached, found by a prefix of the hash of your key. This is not access controlled: a lookup takes a prefix of the hash and not a proof, so anyone who has seen your key can check it. Anyone who has not cannot find it by trying, at 8 characters minimum. It lives at most 120 seconds and there is no list-all route, so what it protects is where you were, not where you are. Keep private detail out of the tags. body is the exact JSON text you signed: {"w": "...", "tags": [...], "ttl": n} with up to 8 short lowercase tags and ttl from 5 to 120 seconds. Sign "aamio-presence-v1\n" + key + "\n" + sha256hex(body). The record expires and must be refreshed. There is no list-all route, which is not the same as being unfindable.
